author: Huawei
description:
Join us at #HUAWEICONNECT 2026, taking place September 17–19 at the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center and Shanghai Expo Center.
 
Under the theme "Advancing the Agentic World," this year's event will explore how AI is moving deeper into industries and how organizations can build the infrastructure needed to apply intelligence at scale.
 
Across more than 300 keynotes, summits, and sessions, #Huawei, customers, partners, industry leaders, and technical experts will share the latest developments in AI for industries. Visitors can also explore a 22,000 m² exhibition featuring Huawei's latest products and scenario-specific solutions, customer AI success stories, and applications from partners.
 
The event will also showcase developer tools and platforms, open-source and collaboration initiatives, and opportunities to help build a thriving AI ecosystem.
 
See you in Shanghai: https://bit.ly/4fSGotw
title: Advancing the Agentic World at HUAWEI CONNECT 2026
